senses.gloss:
तुन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, struck, hit; pricked; goaded,
tormented, hurt, vexed, injured; cut, broken, cut
down &c.; (अस्), m. the Toon or Tuna tree, the
wood of which bears some resemblance to mahogany
and is used for furniture &c.; Cedrela Toona.
—तुन्न-वाय, अस्, m. a tailor.
—तुन्न-सेवनी,
f. the suture of a wound (in surgery); a suture of
the skull.
तुन्न तुन्न. See under rt. 1. तुद् above.

तुन तुन, अस्, अम्, m. n. (?), Ved. a various
reading (in the Sāma-veda) for तन, posterity.

तुन्द् तुन्द्, cl. 1. P. तुन्दति, &c., to be
busy, active; to search, seek; [cf. rt.
त्रन्द्.]

तुन्द तुन्द, अम्, n. (said to be fr. rt. 1. तुद्),
a protuberant belly, the belly, abdomen; (अस्, ई), m. f.
the navel.
—तुन्द-कूपिका or तुन्द-कूपी, f. the
cavity of the navel.
—तुन्द-परिमार्ज, अस्, आ, अम्,
one who is in the habit of stroking his belly (in the
literal sense).
—तुन्द-परिमृज, अस्, आ, अम्, one
who is in the habit of rubbing his belly (meta-
phorically), a lazy man, a sloth, a sluggard.
—तुन्द-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, corpulent, fat.

तुन्दि, इस्, इ, f. n. the belly; (इस्), f. the navel;
(इस्), m., N. of a Gandharva.

तुन्दिक, अस्, आ, अम्, having a large or prominent
navel or belly, fat, corpulent; (आ), f. the navel.

तुन्दित, अस्, आ, अम्, or तुन्दिन्, ई, इनी, इ, or
तुन्दिभ or तुन्दिल, अस्, आ, अम्, having a large or
prominent belly or navel; gorbellied, corpulent.
—तुन्दिल-फला, f. Cucumis Utilissimus.
